fusions.name: Catchbarb Jab
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back. A barbed strike that deals 9 damage, slows the target by 30% for 2 seconds and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hyphal Trawl
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of barbed filaments ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Haul In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A cloud of spores fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag Tithe
fusions.desc: When you strike, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
